title: Failing test, then Fuyutsuki writes the Eva entry with the model, gated and with fallback
goal: retellChronicleDayWithPilot uses the approved voice prompt, in Italian and English, and falls back to the template when the text fails the check
acceptance: A failing test (committed first) with a fake model: a reply in the approved voice that cites every recorded source passes; a reply that omits a source, names an unrecorded source or base ID, is empty or throws returns the template entry with fallback true; today the prompt is one line and nothing calls the function

The prompt carries the approved voice, the language, the day's facts as data and the rule that nothing unrecorded may be named; the model is the main model (gemma4:26b) with the configured fallback (12b) when the first fails to load; one retry at most before the template
The Simple composer is untouched and still model-free (its tests unchanged); no new fact kinds
Tests use the fake model only; no network or real model in the suite
privacy: Neutral invented bases, pilots, sorties and days only; no owner data, tokens or real conversation text in Git, tests or logs.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one prompt, one retry and fallback chain over existing functions, with tests for each failure path. Not a measurement.
